title: VCAP Escrow Hold
description: Created by the marketplace when a negotiation reaches ACCEPTED. Represents funds held in escrow pending verified delivery.

message_type.description: Discriminator for the VCAP message type.

escrow_id.description: Unique identifier for this escrow hold, generated by the marketplace.

negotiation_id.description: References the negotiation_id that triggered this escrow.

source_wallet.description: Requester's wallet or account identifier. May be an internal wallet ID, Stripe account, or crypto address.

destination_wallet.description: Provider's wallet or account identifier. Funds are released here on verified delivery.

amount.description: Amount held in escrow in decimal currency units.

status.description: Current status of the escrow. On creation this is always HELD.

release_condition.description: Human-readable memo linking the escrow to the negotiation and its release criteria.

held_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the escrow hold was created.

metadata.description: OPTIONAL implementation-specific metadata (e.g., AP2 payment intent ID, dispute window).
